name: Pep Guardiola
bio: Famous for his obsessive tactical perfectionism and high-possession style, Guardiola revolutionized modern football at Barcelona, Bayern Munich, and Manchester City.
style: Guardiola is the leading advocate of 'Juego de Posición' (Positional Play). His teams utilize short passes, extreme high press, building out from the goalkeeper, and using inverted fullbacks or defenders stepping into midfield to create central overloads.

timeline.title: Barcelona Appointment
timeline.description: Promoted to first-team manager, shifting the squad towards a possession-heavy style.

timeline.title: Historic Sextuple
timeline.description: Won all six available club trophies in his debut season, a football first.

timeline.title: Bayern Munich Project
timeline.description: Brought his possession style to Germany, winning three Bundesliga titles in a row.

timeline.title: Centurions Season
timeline.description: Led Manchester City to a record-breaking 100 points in the Premier League.

timeline.title: Treble Victory
timeline.description: Won the Champions League, Premier League, and FA Cup in a historic campaign.

timeline.title: Manchester City Farewell
timeline.description: Left City after a decade and 20 trophies, signing off with a domestic cup double.
